Order 
% 06.10.2025 CRL.M.(BAIL) 2033/2025 (interim bail)
1.

This is an application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 read with Section 439 of the Code of Criminal procedure, 1973, seeking grant of interim bail on behalf of the petitioner/applicant, Dharmendra Kumar, in connection with FIR No. 344/2025 registered at Police Station - Paharganj under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. The brief facts as emerging from the record are that the petitioner, serving as a Sub-Inspector with the Border Security Force (hereinafter "BSF"), stands as an accused in the above-noted FIR alleging commission of the aforementioned offence.
The FIR was registered on 05.07.2025, on the complaint of a Constable of U.P. Police.
The complainant alleged that the petitioner had sexual relations with her on a false promise of marriage after administering an intoxicant.
This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 06/10/2025 at 21:54:00 3.
The petitioner was arrested on 22.07.2025 and has since been in judicial custody.
The petitioner was earlier granted interim bail by this Court vide order dated 22.08.2025 to attend his interview for the post of Assistant Commandant with the BSF, which was held on 27.08.2025.

Subsequently,
vide order dated 19.09.2025 in CRL.M.(BAIL) 1960/2025, interim bail was again granted to the petitioner to enable him to appear for the medical examination scheduled tentatively between 22.09.2025 and 26.09.2025.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr. Saurabh Upadhyay, submits that the present application has been filed seeking interim bail for a limited period to enable the petitioner to appear in the Dharmendra Kumar vs State Of Nct Of Delhi on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148565330/
1 medical examination for the post of Assistant Commandant with the BSF.

sentences.text: 5. It is submitted that the petitioner, who is presently serving as a Sub- Inspector in BSF, has already cleared the written examination and the interview stage of the Limited Departmental Competitive Examination conducted by BSF for promotion to the said post.

The counsel points out that the petitioner has received an official communication from the Office of the Commandant, BSF,
informing him that the medical examination for qualified candidates is scheduled on 10.10.2025.
A copy of the said communication has been annexed with the present application.

6. It is further submitted that unless the petitioner is permitted to appear before the Medical Board on the said dates, his candidature will stand forfeited, thereby causing irreparable prejudice to his service career.
The petitioner, being a serving officer of a disciplined armed force, has deep roots in society and is neither a flight risk nor likely to misuse the concession of interim bail.

Learned counsel emphasizes that the petitioner has previously been granted interim bail by this Court, first,
to attend his interview on 27.08.2025 and thereafter, to appear for medical examination scheduled between 22.09.2025 and 26.09.2025; and on both occasions, he duly complied with the conditions imposed, surrendered within the
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 06/10/2025 at 21:54:00 stipulated time, and did not misuse the liberty granted.
It is thus urged that the petitioner deserves to be enlarged on interim bail for the limited period covering the dates of his medical examination.

7. Heard. Issue Notice.
8.

Learned APP, appearing on advance notice, accepted notice and submitted that the petitioner has been earlier granted bail for the limited purpose of appearing before the competent authority to clear examination.

Thus, he submits that he has no objection to the present application, having been allowed,
9.
Heard the parties and perused the record including the past orders of this Court dated 22.08.2025 and 19.09.2025.

The said orders clearly record that the petitioner had earlier been released on interim bail for limited purposes, i.e., first, to attend his interview on 27.08.2025, and thereafter, to appear for medical examination scheduled between 22.09.2025 and 26.09.2025.
10.

The communication dated 03.10.2025 issued from the Commandant, BSF, confirms that the final stage of medical examination under the departmental selection process for Assistant Commandant is fixed for 10.10.2025.
This fact stands verified, as submitted in the Court today by the Investigation Officer.
11. The petitioner has already been granted interim bail on previous occasions and there is no allegation as regard to misuse of the interim bail given to him.

Further, considering the aforesaid and that the interim release sought is only for a short and specific purpose relating to his official examination, which is to appear for medical examination, this Court finds merit in the prayer for Dharmendra Kumar vs State Of Nct Of Delhi on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148565330/
2 grant of interim bail.

sentences.text:
12. Accordingly, the present application is allowed and the petitioner is released on interim bail w.e.f. 08.10.2025 to 15.10.2025 on the following conditions:
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 06/10/2025 at 21:54:00 a.
The petitioner shall furnish a personal bond of 30,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court.
b. The concerned Jail Superintendent shall handover a chit to the petitioner containing the exact date of his surrender to avoid any miscommunication.
The petitioner shall surrender immediately on the expiry of the bail period before the concerned Jail Superintendent.
c. The petitioner shall not attempt to contact or influence the complainant or any witnesses, or tamper with evidence, in any manner.
d. The petitioner shall provide his mobile number to the Investigating Officer and keep it operational at all times during the bail period.
He shall also provide his residential address.
e. It is further directed that if the date of medical examination of the applicant gets deferred to some other date, he shall surrender forthwith.
f. A copy of the order be sent to the concerned Jail Superintendent for information and necessary compliance.
13. The application stands disposed of in the above terms.
14. Order dasti under signatures of the Court Master.
AJAY DIGPAUL, J OCTOBER 6, 2025/
